sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is informant and proceeding is pending since 2020, charge-sheet has been submitted on 03.12.2020.
Learned counsel for the applicant next submitted that no charge has been framed by trial court.
Prayer has been made to expedite trial within stipulated period.
4. Considering the arguments raised by learned counsel for the applicant.

Since charge has not been framed, trial court be directed to frame the charge and decide the aforesaid case in accordance with law, as expeditiously as possible, without granting any unnecessary or long adjournments to either of the parties.
5. With above observations, the application under section 482 Cr.P.C. is disposed of.
